t: 亨利六世(德语:Henry VI)是德国国王,由塞拉斯蒂涅三世教皇加冕为神圣罗马皇帝.
te: Henry VI, King of Germany, is crowned Holy Roman Emperor by pope Celestine III.
dz: 亨利六世(德语:Henry VI)是德国国王,由塞拉斯蒂涅三世教皇加冕为神圣罗马皇帝.
de: Henry VI, King of Germany, is crowned Holy Roman Emperor by pope Celestine III.

t: 英国理查一世在塞浦路斯与纳瓦拉的贝伦加里亚结婚；同一天，她被加冕为英国王后。
te: Richard I of England marries Berengaria of Navarre in Cyprus; she is crowned Queen consort of England the same day.
dz: 英国理查一世在塞浦路斯与纳瓦拉的贝伦加里亚结婚；同一天，她被加冕为英国王后。
de: Richard I of England marries Berengaria of Navarre in Cyprus; she is crowned Queen consort of England the same day.

t: 理查一世国王率领的英国军队抵达阿卡，加入已经抵达的第三次十字军东征的法国和德国军队。
te: English forces under King Richard I arrive in Acre, joining the already arrived French and German forces of the Third C…
dz: 理查一世国王率领的英国军队抵达阿卡，加入已经抵达的第三次十字军东征的法国和德国军队。
de: English forces under King Richard I arrive in Acre, joining the already arrived French and German forces of the Third Crusade.

t: 萨拉丁的驻军向菲利普·奥古斯都投降，结束了对阿卡两年的围困。
te: Saladin's garrison surrenders to Philip Augustus, ending the two-year siege of Acre.
dz: 第三次十字军东征：萨拉丁的驻军向菲利普·奥古斯都投降，结束了对阿卡两年的围困。
de: Third Crusade: Saladin's garrison surrenders to Philip Augustus, ending the two-year siege of Acre.

t: 英格兰的理查德一世相信萨拉丁违背赎金承诺,在Ayyadieh发动了大屠杀,斩首了2 700名被…
te: Believing Saladin had reneged on ransom promises, Richard I of England initiates the massacre at Ayyadieh, beheading 2,…
dz: 英格兰的理查德一世相信萨拉丁违背赎金承诺,在Ayyadieh发动了大屠杀,斩首了2 700名被俘的穆斯林士兵和在Acre瀑布被俘的另外300名妇女和儿童.
de: Believing Saladin had reneged on ransom promises, Richard I of England initiates the massacre at Ayyadieh, beheading 2,700 captive Muslim soldiers and another 300 women and children seized at the Fall of Acre.

t: 阿尔苏夫之战：英格兰理查一世在阿尔苏夫击败萨拉丁。
te: Battle of Arsuf: Richard I of England defeats Saladin at Arsuf.
dz: 第三次十字军东征：阿尔苏夫之战：英格兰理查一世在阿尔苏夫击败萨拉丁。
de: Third Crusade: Battle of Arsuf: Richard I of England defeats Saladin at Arsuf.
